links.outcome: MedDRA coding accuracy of retrieval-grounded LLM versus zero-shot generation and random candidate selection
links.effect: RAG pipeline reached LLT exact accuracy 50-58%, PT 78-85%, SOC 90-93%, and expert clinical acceptability 91-97%; zero-shot and random selection performed substantially worse.
links.quote: Zero-shot generation and random candidate selection performed substantially worse.

unlisted_practices: Dense semantic retrieval of a constrained candidate set outperformed lexical retrieval for candidate inclusion
Combining hierarchical automated metrics with clinical expert validation because strict string agreement underestimates clinical appropriateness

screen.reason: Evaluates a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework versus unguided zero-shot LLM generation for standardizing clinical trial adverse event coding with expert clinical review.
